raw_snappy_hot_points.policy: Existing eight-hit/256-hit retry, 64 KiB and 1/16 cache limits; already decoded raw rows copied once into cache storage with atomic construction-credit handoff.

warm_sparse_snapshot_batches.scope: Warm shared decoded block; owner retains cache pins, results survive invalidation; output arrays and pin metadata warmed before counters.

bounds.codec_eligibility: Borrow warm raw rows or values inside retained none/plain-prefix physical payloads. Temporary Snappy and prefix key storage never becomes a result owner.

scope: Isolated native Debug production helper fixtures with C result/scratch allocators. Deterministic allocation/admission counts; timing samples are indicative and do not establish end-to-end QPS or a 2 GiB soak.
